Abstract; Time-frequency analysis on track irregularity and accurate extraction of detrimental wavelengths cau-sing car-body excitation are of great importance to the repair and maintenance of railway lines.

This paper pro-posed the automatic extraction algorithm of track irregularity characteristic (detrimental) wavelengths: At first, acquiring adaptively the track irregularity and car-body vibration signals in all frequency bands with the DWT (Discrete Wavelet Transform) method, and then analyzing the (cross) Wigner-Ville time-frequency ener-gies for the signals; using the HT (Hough Transform) to further suppress the cross distracters; deriving the formula for extracting track irregularity characteristic (detrimental) wavelengths lastly.

Through the track inspection data analysis for Shanghai-Nanjing Passenger Dedicated Railway and Shenchi- Huanghua Heavy Haul Railway, the results show that the method this paper proposed can effectively extract the type, damage degree and space position of small disease, and realize the evaluation of track irregularity′s overall state.

Based on the continue wavelet transform′s detailed performance in time-scale mesh generation, and combined with the probability method, the time, scale and time-scale wavelet energy spectrum of train vibration response and track irregularity signal was estab-lished after the calculating and analyzing of track irregularity and train vibration energy, then the combined diagnosis and analysis was conducted.

Firstly, we clustered the track irregularity samples under different evaluation indexes and different car-body vibration states respectively, extracted the characteristic statistical parameters, and then the process of PCA dimensionality reduction and message optimization was conducted.

With the methods of site investigation, testing and calculation analysis, useful discussions of rail wear, Sanzhe, rail breaking and initial deflection, parameters of fastener and rail joint bolt torque, service state and geometric parameters of ballast bed, cold damage, track irregularity, are proposed.
Besides, the track irregularity spatial series should be constructed with the requirement of vehicle -track (or vehicle - bridge) system dynamical simulation being taken into consideration.

Therefore, based on the domestic inverse al-gorithms of spectrum density which have been relatively matured, and the consideration of the uniformity in the conversion process of spectrum density in time and frequency domain, this paper proposed a simplified inverse algorithm which can directly simulate any wave -band at any length of the track irregularity spatial series on the basis of acquiring the spectrum density structure and fitting parameters.

The theories of time-frequency analysis and energy mutation over characteristic waveforms were used to study the positioning and extraction of track irregularity characteristic wavelengths and track diseases.

Combining wavelet transform’s multi-resolution analytical characteristics and Wigner-Ville distribution’s high time-frequency energy-focusing performance, a wavelet-SPWVE time-frequency algorithm of locating and extracting track irregularity wavelength was proposed and compared with the conventional scale-wavelet energy spectrum analysis method.

The Karhunen-Loève expansion method is applied to grasp the random features of fluctuating winds and the track random irregularities are generated by application of the track irregularity probabilistic model.

The core idea of this method is the probability density distribution patterns of vibration responses of vehicle-track coupling system are basically determined under joint random fields of different track irregularity excitation sources and system parameters.
Using the discrete probability integration and statistical approaches, the massively measured track irregularity time histories were divided into multiple time-domain sequences.
The representative track irregularity spectra were selected through the commonly random simulation methods, and the track random irregularities were inversely simulated.
The worse the track irregularity is, the smaller the longitudinal length of the joint required for the damage initiation of the track slab and reaching the maximum tensile damage.

The unrecoverable plastic strain generated by the damage will also lead to the change of the geometric state of the track structure, and then worsen the track irregularity, resulting in the vicious cycle of damage deterioration of the track structure and aggravation of the track irregularity.

By selecting appropriate wavelet functions, the track irregularity and car -body vibration signal were transformed through continues wavelet method, and then the time -frequency feature of the track irregularity was analyzed by setting the wavelet coefficients as the evaluation index of the track smooth state.
At last, the track irregularity time−frequency analyze method based on the PSD (Power spectrum Density)-HHT (Hilbert−Huang Transform) was proposed.

According to the track geometry data collected by track recording vehicles from Shenchi—Huanghua Heavy Haul Railway, the comparative analysis was conducted between German railway spectra of high irregularity and low irregularity and the actual measurement track irregularity spectra of Shenchi-Huanghua Heavy Haul Railway.
Then the coherence theory was adopted to analyze track irregularity and train vibration acceleration, and based on this, the train's detrimental wavelength caused by track irregularity was studied.

The track irregularity also has a significant effect on vertical acceleration of the car -body, and the periodic shortwave range 2—3.5 m induced by cross -level and twist irregularity has an adverse impact on vertical and lateral vibration.
Additionally, the track irregularity, as the primary self-excitation source in the system, demonstrates apparent randomness and time-varying characteristics.

The track irregularity probability model and spectral representation-stochastic function method were employed to efficiently achieve the simulation of track irregularity in the finite random variable space.

The effects of long-wavelength additional track deformation and the interlayer dynamic contact on the vehicle-induced vibrations were analyzed based on the integration of the conventional track irregularity excitation.
